directGateway.runtimeCredential: Canonical owner credential created only inside isolated compute at start, revoked on gateway drain, excluded together with staging and .claude auth/session tree from checkpoints; never image or tracked config
limitations: These are source/tsx gateway timings under local amd64 emulation, not a production compiled gateway or Cloudflare remote wake measurement.
One task per owner in spike.
Runtime DSN static and safe only for one explicitly allowlisted spike owner; production requires owner-specific database/role resolution.
Full home uses native DirectoryBackup; only spike-result.txt and assistant output are projected into shared read APIs.
No full Chat websocket proxy; only explicitly tracked Queue actions may execute.
Local timings include linux/amd64 emulation on an Apple Silicon host, source/tsx imports and development tooling. They are not remote Cloudflare latency or p95 measurements.
Direct gateway image size in the earlier sample is superseded by the later Dockerfile image; do not compare those image sizes as the same artifact.
Additional recovery-path hardening was tested after the live normal-path sample; the benchmark is not a measurement of a committed final head.
Single allowlisted compute owner; separate kernel and shared-control test databases. No production Free signup, billing, full Chat/Terminal WebSocket bridge or automatic SDK-session resume shipped.
